items.title: Queens of the Stone Age with Pixies, Moda Center (May 9, 2027)
items.action: Presale registration closed Oct 25; if you registered, watch for your presale (TicketNews says Wed Oct 28, while Ticketmaster's listing has shown Tue Oct 27 at 10 a.m. PDT). Public sale Thu Oct 29 at 10 a.m.
items.why: A 16-date arena run for new album Perfecth with Pixies opening every night; sources disagree on the presale day, so check Ticketmaster.

items.title: 2hollis, Roseland Theater (Mar 10 and 11, 2027)
items.action: Sign up on Laylo for the artist presale Tue Oct 27 at 10 a.m. (venue presale 11 a.m.); general sale Wed Oct 28 at 10 a.m.
items.why: Two Portland nights on the newly announced Pirouette tour, with presale access through Laylo sign-up.

items.title: Iron Maiden, Moda Center (Apr 18, 2027)
items.action: General sale opened Fri Oct 23 at 10 a.m. through Live Nation; buy face value there rather than resale.
items.why: Surprise 2027 North American return with Bullet for My Valentine and The Raven Age.

items.title: Portland Thorns NWSL playoff match (possible home quarterfinal)
items.action: Watch Thorns.com after the Nov 1 regular-season finale at Houston to see if Portland hosts a quarterfinal, then buy direct from the club.
items.why: The Thorns clinched a 10th straight playoff berth on Oct 23, but their seed (and whether they host) won't be set until after Nov 1; last year's home quarterfinal drew 19,309.

items.title: Angine de Poitrine, Crystal Ballroom (Dec 10 and 11)
items.action: Check Ticketmaster, the listed official seller, for face-value seats before turning to resale.
items.why: Two nights at the Crystal Ballroom, with resale listings starting around $168 to $205 a ticket.

items.title: Oregon vs. Oregon State basketball, Moda Center (Nov 19)
items.action: On sale now through Ticketmaster and the Moda Center box office.
items.why: First Civil War meeting in Portland since 1996; public sale opened Oct 22.

items.title: ZooLights at the Oregon Zoo (Nov 20 to Jan 3)
items.action: Buy dated tickets ahead; prices range $13 to $35 by night, and Any Night tickets work Nov 20 to Dec 31.
items.why: Tickets are sold in advance online and price varies by date, so earlier and weeknight picks are cheaper.

items.title: Oregon Ballet Theatre: Balanchine's The Nutcracker (Dec 5 to 24)
items.action: Single tickets are on sale from OBT; buy direct for face value rather than resale.
items.why: Runs at Keller Auditorium Dec 5 to 24, with a noon show on Christmas Eve.

items.title: Christmas Ships viewing dinner
items.action: Check the 2026 route schedule, then reserve a riverside window table for a night the fleet passes.
items.why: Vancouver's tourism office advises reserving waterfront restaurant seats well in advance on parade nights (Vancouver nights listed Dec 16 to 18).

items.title: Kann: December reservations
items.action: Book on Resy Nov 1 at noon, when the next month's tables are released.
items.why: Kann's FAQ says it releases one month of reservations on the 1st of the prior month at noon; confirm the schedule is still current.

items.title: Timberline and Mt. Hood Fusion season passes
items.action: Buy before Nov 1, when prices go up again; Fusion Passes stop selling after Nov 29.
items.why: Timberline cut pass prices this year and steps them up over time; KATU reports the current adult tier at $849.

items.title: Skibowl season pass Tier 1 pricing
items.action: Buy by Oct 31 to keep Tier 1 pricing (the Skibowl homepage says Nov 3, so check).
items.why: Skibowl's pass page says Tier 1 ends Oct 31; adult passes are listed at $589.

items.title: Mt. Hood Meadows season pass
items.action: Buy sooner rather than later; there is no fixed deadline.
items.why: Meadows uses dynamic pricing, so pass prices rise as more are sold.

items.title: Epic Pass price increase
items.action: Buy before Nov 15 to beat the next price step; sales end Dec 6.
items.why: Powder lists the Epic Pass at $1,169 as of Oct 13, with the next increase Nov 15.

items.title: Ikon Pass final sales window
items.action: Buy by Dec 10 at the current $1,529 adult price.
items.why: Ikon shows the current price valid until Dec 10; last year sales stopped Dec 11.

items.title: Oregon Sno-Park permit season starts
items.action: Get a permit before parking at a Mt. Hood Sno-Park: $25 annual (also sold online at DMV2U), $9 for three days or $4 for one day from vendors or a DMV office.
items.why: A permit is required Nov 1 to Apr 30, permits aren't sold on site and vendors often sell out, and DMV stopped selling daily and three-day permits online in 2026.

items.title: Mt. Hood National Forest Christmas tree permit
items.action: Watch Recreation.gov for this year's $5 permits and print yours; digital copies aren't accepted.
items.why: The Forest Service says the season is closed and reopens in November 2026; last year it opened Nov 14. Permits are $5 plus a $2.50 Recreation.gov fee, five per household.

items.title: Sauvie Island Farms U-cut Christmas trees
items.action: Check the farm for 2026 dates; last year U-cut ran Nov 21 to Dec 24, 9 to 5, self-serve, $60 a tree.
items.why: Those are 2025 details; the farm hasn't posted 2026 tree dates yet.

items.title: Coast state park campsites
items.action: Book Fort Stevens or Nehalem Bay exactly six months before your arrival date on the state's reservation site.
items.why: Oregon State Parks takes reservations up to six months ahead; Cape Lookout's campground has been closed for improvements since Aug 3, 2026.

items.title: Portland Nursery Last Call fall sale
items.action: Get spring bulbs and garlic at 30% off at either SE Portland store by Wed Oct 28.
items.why: The fall sale was extended through Oct 28, with pumpkins and gourds at 50% off.

items.title: Barnes & Noble Criterion 50% off sale
items.action: Hold Criterion 4K wish-list buys for November.
items.why: B&N runs the half-off Criterion sale every July and November (last November's began Nov 7); 2026 dates aren't announced yet.
